subject: Proposal: AtlasOps connector — hybrid channel and revenue model
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@atlasops.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@atlasops.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnering inquiry — AtlasOps connector and GTM

Marissa,

Great to meet at Inference Summit last month — appreciate the intro to Redwood's platform. AtlasOps has been building an enterprise connector that routes telemetry into Redwood's embeddings pipeline; we've had inbound interest from three customers that want a packaged solution with joint billing.

High level ask: we'd like to propose a commercial partnership where AtlasOps can sell the connector bundled with Redwood (either as a reseller on cited accounts or as a referral partner where we drive leads and get credits). We think a hybrid model makes sense because some customers buy AtlasOps services + Redwood seats, others want simple introductions.

Attached are our traffic and ARR estimates for the first 12 months (hi-level). Please review and let me know if your partnerships / sales ops and legal teams are open to a short MPA + commercial term sheet.

Attachment: [AtlasOps_traffic_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

We can share a draft SOW for implementation revenue split if helpful. Looking forward to a quick call — Elena (CPO) is CC'd and can join.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Partnerships
AtlasOps

---
On Tue, 1 Sep 2026 at 08:05, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Samir — I'll loop in Partnerships and Sales Ops to map a simple working model.
> 
> -Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@atlasops.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnering inquiry — AtlasOps connector and GTM

Samir — thanks for the packet. Quick read and a few proposal points from Redwood's side below. Copying Ben (sales ops) and Karthik (partnerships) to surface questions from Legal/Revenue Ops.

High-level recommended approach (hybrid):

1) Referral credit flow (low-friction):
   - For leads AtlasOps registers via HubSpot form/link and that convert to paid Redwood customers, AtlasOps receives a one-time referral credit equal to 8% of first-year Redwood ARR attributable to that customer (paid as a one-time cash/credit within 60 days of invoice).
   - Registration must include capture of Atlassian/HubSpot ID and sales rep attribution; claim window = 90 days from lead creation.

2) Reseller option (bundled deals):
   - For deals where AtlasOps invoices the end customer for a bundle (AtlasOps services + Redwood subscription), Redwood offers a 20% revenue share on Redwood billed portion for year 1, 10% for year 2, with standard clawback if Redwood invoices are unpaid or cancelled within 120 days.
   - AtlasOps will be listed as an authorized reseller for named accounts signed to the MPA; reseller must maintain resale certification (short e-learn).

3) Implementation and services split:
   - For professional services sold by AtlasOps that are strictly AtlasOps scope (SOW delivered by AtlasOps), revshare not applied. For joint-delivery SOWs (Redwood PM + AtlasOps engineer), recommend a 25/75 split (AtlasOps/Redwood) for implementation fees for the initial 6 months of the program.

4) Exclusivity & territories:
   - No exclusivity by default. For named-account co-sell arrangements we can discuss short-term exclusivity if AtlasOps commits to minimum ARPA or pipeline milestones.

Action items:
- Ben: draft registration form and claim window language for review.
- Karthik: confirm partner tiering and co-sell credit eligibility.
- Samir: confirm whether AtlasOps prefers 60- or 90-day claim window, and share legal contact for MPA routing.

If this high-level looks reasonable I can ask Legal to produce a one-page MPA and a simple commercial term exhibit for review. Happy to set up 30m tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Redwood_Partner_MPA_v1.pdf]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@atlasops.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnering inquiry — AtlasOps connector and GTM

Samir / Marissa — quick operational clarifications from Sales Ops before we hand to Legal: 

1) Lead registration mechanics:
   - HubSpot canonical form ID is required; leads registered via email thread without form evidence will need sales ops review. We prefer a shared tracking link (we'll create a partner registration portal token).

2) Attribution and BDR handoffs:
   - If AtlasOps books an intro but a Redwood AE converts later, referral credit applies if the registered lead is present in HubSpot and not previously owned by Redwood. Co-selling motions where a Redwood AE needs to run contract negotiations will default to the reseller revenue-share if AtlasOps invoices.

3) Payment timing and reporting:
   - Referral credits paid quarterly against Redwood invoices; reseller revshare remitted monthly with an itemized statement. Clawback rules applied to returned/cancelled invoices within 120 days.

4) DocuSign and MPA routing:
   - We'll need an executed MPA + reseller appendix before we issue reseller authorization. I'll provision a DocuSign envelope and share today.

Attachment: [Redwood_Partner_MPA_v1.pdf] (we usually attach redlineable PDF)

Also adding this to HubSpot (Deal: ATL-1347) for pipeline visibility. Samir — can you confirm the top-3 target accounts you plan to register first? That will speed the MPA/authorization.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Samir Patel <samir@atlasops.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@atlasops.com>, contracts@atlasops.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnering inquiry — AtlasOps connector and GTM

Marissa / Ben — thanks, that structure is very close to what we had in mind. A few proposed edits from AtlasOps legal/ops: 

- For referral credit: would AtlasOps be open to a 9% first-year credit instead of 8%? Our CFO prefers a rounder arithmetic to reconcile with channel ops.
- For reseller revshare: can we adjust implementation revshare to 25% to AtlasOps for joint SOWs for the first 6 months (we're committing a named engineer resource to accelerate first three pilots).
- Claim window: AtlasOps would prefer 60 days instead of 90 for the lead registration claim window — our sales cycle is short and we'd like faster validation to avoid stale leads.
- Clawback exceptions: request carve-outs for customer credits issued for product defects if those are not related to AtlasOps deliverables.

We can take the redline once you push the MPA into DocuSign. I'll ask contracts@atlasops.com to prepare a short redline (expect by Monday). Also happy to take a 30m call Monday to lock final numbers.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Samir

--
Samir Patel
Head of Partnerships | AtlasOps
samir@atlasops.com
